newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Democrats demand senator ousting.
newsitem.headline: Australian Democrats demand senator ousting.

text.p: A powerful Australian minority party on Monday demanded the ousting of a key senator, whose support is vital to the passage of government legislation.

Australian Democrats leader Cheryl Kernot said her party was considering how it could force Mal Colston, who faces allegations of abusing allowances, to relinquish the Senate deputy presidency when the upper house resumes in May.
Kernot also called on Colston to quit before the Senate sits, saying the evidence against him was damning.
